label: Interface Walkthrough
description: Draft portrait package for product UI walkthroughs that keep interface state, user focus, and next action readable.

renderCost.notes: Fixed application chrome and frame-driven focus entrances.

reducedMotion.notes: Reduced policies preserve screen geometry and use only restrained opacity transitions.

accessibility.notes: High-contrast labels, explicit focus states, text labels alongside color, and a fixed caption-safe area.

directorCompatibility.selectionReason: Use when a product interface and its next user action are the primary visual evidence.
hardBlocks: Registration remains pending outside this package ownership.

sourcePolicy.notes: Draft implementation uses deterministic local interface fixtures. No source approval or visual-pattern claim is made.

tokens.palette: graphite chrome with blue focus, green completion, amber review, and red blocked states
tokens.typography: UI sans for interface labels and compact system mono for metadata

layoutGrammar: Keep the product interface as the dominant visible artifact.
Use an explicit focus ring and textual action label.
Reserve a stable lower caption-safe panel.
Do not animate interface dimensions, navigation position, or table rows.
Keep walkthrough copy subordinate to the screen state.

componentPrimitives.notes: Stable navigation, toolbar, and interface canvas.
Textual action label paired with a visible focus boundary.

knownLimitations: This draft is not registered for runtime selection.
No approved source or visual-pattern claim is included.
